criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.note: First two lines name the governor, the exact dollar claim, the asset class, and signal a correction without snark. Stops short of 10 because the correction mechanism (TCO vs cooling share) isn't named until paragraph 4.

criteria.name: Claim load-bearing + AK stakes
criteria.note: A sitting governor's primary quantitative pitch to hyperscalers at a named event; correction names Amazon, Meta, Microsoft, DigitalBridge, Stak Energy, Port MacKenzie and the 2025-26 siting window with explicit stranded-asset risk.

criteria.name: Steelman fairness
criteria.note: Paragraph 3 is generous and specific: confirms the differential is real, calls free-air cooling proven, validates PUE, calls the pitch rational. No snark, before the rebuttal.

criteria.name: Counter-evidence quality
criteria.note: Two of three rebuttal points trace cleanly (UAF ACEP 5% primary; Jones/EIA rate data). The GPU liquid-cooling bullet is industry fact without a dossier entry or inline source.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.note: Named specifics in nearly every sentence; satisfies the 1-2 sentence cadence.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.note: Claim attribution uses two independent outlets; counter-evidence uses UAF ACEP (primary) plus EIA-via-Jones (secondary). GPU bullet untraceable, holding it to 7.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.note: Analytical, structural, business-literate. Brand register throughout, corrective not contemptuous.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.note: 442 words, 2737 chars, tight paragraphs, one 3-item bullet block, no nesting.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.note: Real, debatable, tied to the corrected TCO frame, no softener or CTA.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.note: A CFO can immediately re-run Alaska siting math with electricity rate as the dominant TCO variable; named revisit triggers.

one_sentence_fix: Source the GPU liquid-cooling bullet to a primary entry in claim_dossier.json so every rebuttal point traces to a verifiable source.
